newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Osem value $490-$530 mln.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Osem value $490-$530 mln.

text.p: Bank Hapoalim values Israel's Osem Investments Ltd at $490 million to $530 million against a market value of $480 million, the bank said in a report on the company.

It estimates Osem will have a net profit of 76.8 million shekels in 1996 and of 88.9 million shekels in 1997, up from 69.3 million in 1995. In the first half of the year the company reported a net profit of 31.2 million shekels against a net profit of 33.6 million in the same period last year.
Bank Hapoalim estimates Osem's earnings per share (EPS) at 0.97 shekels in 1996 and 1.11 shekels in 1997, against EPS of 0.96 shekels in 1995.
Swiss food giant Nestle SA owns 39.7 percent of the company.
